descriptionChirho: To be shaken or caused to tremble physically, said of cosmic bodies, the earth, buildings, or other physical things.
To be shaken metaphorically in one's inner stability or composure, i.e., to be mentally unsettled, disturbed, or moved from a firm position.
To shake something or someone actively, including stirring up people or crowds, or causing physical movement of an object.
To shake a container so its contents settle and compress together, as in compacting a measure of grain.
